**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Parse symbol-prefixed Chinese numerals without 元**

When an explicit RMB symbol prefixes a Chinese numeral without a trailing unit, `normalizeMoneyValueV4('¥四千')`, `normalizeMoneyValueV4('￥四千')`, and `normalizeMoneyValueV4('¥肆仟')` all return `unsupported`, although the token grammar accepts these forms and equivalent `RMB四千`, `人民币四千`, and `￥4000` values normalize to `4000.00`. The omitted-yuan handling recognizes only `RMB_NAME`, so include `¥/￥` in this parsing path to avoid dropping an unambiguous amount.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
